MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into on 23 October 2026 (the "Effective
Date") by and between Acme Technologies Private Limited, a company incorporated under the laws of
India, having its registered office at 12 Business Park, Ludhiana, Punjab 141001 (the "Client"), and
Northwind Consulting LLP, having its principal place of business at 45 Corporate Avenue, Mumbai,
Maharashtra 400001 (the "Service Provider"). The Client and the Service Provider are each referred to as
a "Party" and together as the "Parties".
1. Definitions
1.1 "Services" means the consulting, software development, and support services described in each
Statement of Work executed under this Agreement.
1.2 "Statement of Work" or "SOW" means a written document signed by both Parties that describes the
Services, deliverables, timelines, and fees.
1.3 "Confidential Information" means all non-public information disclosed by one Party to the other,
whether orally, in writing, or electronically, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be
understood to be confidential.
1.4 "Deliverables" means all work product, reports, code, and materials created by the Service Provider
for the Client under a SOW.
2. Scope of Services
2.1 The Service Provider shall perform the Services in accordance with each SOW and shall devote
reasonable skill, care, and diligence consistent with generally accepted industry standards.
2.2 Any change to the scope, timeline, or fees in a SOW must be agreed in writing by both Parties
through a change order before the changed work begins.
3. Fees and Payment
3.1 The Client shall pay the fees set out in the applicable SOW. Unless stated otherwise, the Service
Provider shall invoice monthly and the Client shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of
receipt.
3.2 Late payments shall accrue interest at the rate of one percent (1%) per month, or the maximum rate
permitted by law, whichever is lower.
3.3 All fees are exclusive of applicable taxes, including GST, which shall be payable by the Client in
addition to the fees.

4. Term and Termination
4.1 This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of twenty-four
(24) months, unless terminated earlier in accordance with this Section.
4.2 Either Party may terminate this Agreement or any SOW for convenience by giving ninety (90) days'
prior written notice to the other Party.
4.3 Either Party may terminate this Agreement immediately by written notice if the other Party materially
breaches this Agreement and fails to cure the breach within thirty (30) days after receiving written notice
of the breach.
4.4 Upon termination, the Client shall pay for all Services performed and expenses incurred up to the
effective date of termination.
5. Confidentiality
5.1 Each Party shall hold the other Party's Confidential Information in strict confidence, use it solely to
perform its obligations under this Agreement, and not disclose it to any third party without prior written
consent.
5.2 These obligations do not apply to information that is or becomes publicly available without breach,
was already known to the receiving Party, is independently developed, or is required to be disclosed by
law or court order.
5.3 The obligations in this Section survive for five (5) years after the termination or expiry of this
Agreement.
6. Intellectual Property
6.1 Subject to full payment of the applicable fees, the Client shall own all rights, title, and interest in the
Deliverables created specifically for the Client under a SOW.
6.2 The Service Provider retains ownership of its pre-existing materials, tools, and methodologies, and
grants the Client a non-exclusive, perpetual, royalty-free licence to use them as part of the Deliverables.
7. Warranties and Indemnity
7.1 The Service Provider warrants that the Services will be performed in a professional manner and that
the Deliverables will not knowingly infringe any third-party intellectual property rights.
7.2 Each Party shall indemnify the other against third-party claims, losses, and reasonable legal costs
arising from its gross negligence, wilful misconduct, or breach of Section 5.

DEPARTMENT OF
COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING
Discover. Learn. Empower.
Experiment 2.2
Experiment Title:-
Implementation of Merge Sort Using Divide and Conquer Technique for Recursive Data Sorting
Aim:-
To write a program to implement Merge Sort using the Divide and Conquer technique for recursively
sorting a given set of data.
Topic Name:-
Merge Sort – Divide and Conquer Technique
Objective:-
1
To understand the Divide and Conquer approach.
2
To implement Merge Sort using recursion.
3
To divide an array into smaller subarrays.
4
To merge sorted subarrays into a single sorted array.
5
To analyze the time and space complexity of Merge Sort.
Software Requirements:- Visual Studio Code
Theory:-
Merge Sort:-
Merge Sort is a comparison-based sorting algorithm based on the Divide and Conquer technique. The
algorithm works in three main steps:
•
Divide: Divide the array into two approximately equal halves.
•
Conquer: Recursively sort both halves.
•
Combine: Merge the two sorted halves to form a single sorted array.
The process continues until each subarray contains only one element. A single element is already sorted,
so the subarrays are then merged recursively.
Algorithm
Merge Sort Algorithm
1

2
Take an unsorted array.
3
Find the middle position of the array.
4
Divide the array into two halves.
5
Recursively apply Merge Sort to the left half.
6
Recursively apply Merge Sort to the right half.
7
Merge the two sorted halves.
8
Repeat until the complete array is sorted.
9
Display the sorted array.
10 Stop.
